newsitem.title: POLAND: NFI units seen at PLN 122.5 at year-end.
newsitem.headline: NFI units seen at PLN 122.5 at year-end.

text.p: Polish mass privatisation NFI units are expected to rise on the Warsaw bourse to 122.5 zlotys by the end of the year, brokers surveyed by the financial daily Nowa Europa said on Tuesday.
A month ago brokers forecast the the units would end the year at 120.18 zlotys, 1.93 percent lower than the current prediction.

The units, which started bourse trade on July 15, closed on Monday at 110 zlotys in the regualar bourse session and at 112.5 zlotys in continuous trade. They have risen 26.4 percent on the main market since August 29.

The units have been on offer to Poland's 28 million adults since November at 20 zlotys each and will later be exchangeable for shares in each of the country's 15 National Investment Funds grouping more than 500 firms undergoing privatisation.
So far more than 17.7 million NFI units have been sold on the primary market, with the certificates on offer until late November this year.
